preconditions.description: Attacker must have admin permission (index 0) in the Authorized contract, which is granted to the contract owner by default
Contract must hold BNB (native currency) or other ERC20 tokens in its balance

violation_target.exploit_hint: As an authorized admin (index 0), call the safeWithdraw() function from the Authorized contract to drain all BNB from the contract balance to your wallet. Alternatively, use safeOtherTokens() to transfer any ERC20 tokens held by the contract. No additional steps needed beyond having admin permissions.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The RightContract inherits from Authorized which has a safeWithdraw() function protected by isAuthorized(0) modifier. This allows any address with admin permission (index 0) to drain all native BNB from the contract. By default, the contract owner has this permission. The exploit involves impersonating the owner and calling safeWithdraw().
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner (who has admin permission by default) and call safeWithdraw() to drain all BNB to the attacker's address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner address of the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call safeWithdraw() on the target contract
4. The contract's BNB balance will be transferred to the attacker
